integrity: A complete analytic proof with a separate standard-library finite diagnostic checker is supplied. Numerical checks are not a proof of the all-size assertions. A separately hosted 2024 supplemental file could not be materially inspected; publication priority therefore remains qualified.
scientific_limitations: Exactly the classical reflecting-path Markov limit for odd path lengths at least five; no finite-dephasing quantum statement, no joint size/dephasing uniformity, and only local uniqueness of the relative-entropy crossing.
title: Sharp Mpemba crossing times in finite photonic diffusion chains
